comparison_note: All comparisons use completed days: yesterday (2026-10-11, Sunday) vs day before (2026-10-10, Saturday). Today is excluded as it is an incomplete day.

flags: -16.3% vs day before (threshold -60%) and -16.3% vs same day last month (threshold -20%). The last-month baseline is a Friday, so a Sunday dip is expected, but it's within 4 points of the threshold. Revenue-table quantity (16,351) is within 1% of the view count.

-70.5% vs day before breaches the 60% drop rule. This is very likely a false positive caused by a normal Sunday: the previous two Sundays were 574 and 720, and DIM, Merge and Active all agree at exactly 586. A Sunday vs Saturday comparison will trip this rule most weeks. Consider a same-weekday baseline for Active 1.
All three tables match exactly. There was no bulk spike on Sunday, and Saturday 10 Oct was also clean (Active 1,989 vs Merge 1,990).

Correction to previous runs: the ~1,022-per-store excess in Active did not start on 6 Oct. A 15-day lookback shows Active above Merge by a multiple of ~1,022 on every weekday since at least 28 Sep: +2,046 (28 Sep), +2,045 (29 Sep), +1,021 (30 Sep), +2,035 (1 Oct), +1,024 (2 Oct), +1,022 (3 Oct, Sat), +1,022 (5 Oct), +3,070 (6 Oct), +2,044 (7 Oct), +1,022 (8 Oct), +2,043 (9 Oct). It was clean on 4, 10 and 11 Oct. This is an ongoing daily pattern that is still unexplained.

6,872 is well above the 3,000 RED threshold. It has bounced back up from 3,106 on 9 Oct. Recent readings have swung widely: 5,057 (5 Oct) → 7,460 (7 Oct) → 5,438 (8 Oct) → 3,106 (9 Oct) → 6,872 (12 Oct). Swings of this size suggest the view's population is unstable (refresh timing or logic), not genuine termination movement. Worth checking with whoever owns VW_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTIONS_USAGE_DETAILS.
Merge exceeds SmartConnect by 73 (threshold 10). This time Merge is higher, not SmartConnect.

Almost all of it is the Spot Connect App channel (3 SC vs 73 Merge), plus Spot Connect (1 vs 6), Mobile Store (9 vs 11) and Uconnect App (5 vs 6). App activations being largely absent from the SC RICA report is a recurring structural offset (43–83 on every recent run). On weekdays the bulk SC excess hid it; on a quiet Sunday it trips the threshold on its own.
No tenant had SmartConnect above Merge apart from The Unlimited (+4) and Aheers Build and Save (+1). SPAR, Build It, Midas and Pet Pool & Home all match exactly. No bulk-store spike on Sunday.

No unexpected failures in the last 24h. The only failures were this run's 2 expected pending-access probes (VW_WHOLESALE_USAGE / DATAWAREHOUSE.MVNX). Checked with QUERY_HISTORY_BY_USER and RESULT_LIMIT=>2000.
